yaya.plugin.waifu.label: Realistic chat
yaya.plugin.waifu.desc: Splits replies into chat bubbles, hides the action bar and shows a typing hint — close to a real conversation
yaya.plugin.waifu.cfg_hide_actions: Hide the action bar under replies
yaya.plugin.waifu.cfg_hide_actions_desc: Copy / regenerate / more / usage are hidden; right-click or long-press a bubble still gives every action
yaya.plugin.waifu.cfg_process_desc: Collapsed stays expandable; hidden feels like a plain chat — approvals and question cards are unaffected
yaya.plugin.waifu.cfg_typing_desc: Text under the bubbles while a reply is being generated; empty uses the default “typing…”
